proposal.summary: Prior to version 1.18.7, DataEase contains a deserialization vulnerability in the datasource that can be exploited to execute arbitrary code. The issue is fixed in v1.18.7.
proposal.cwe_quote: Prior to version 1.18.7, a deserialization vulnerability exists in the DataEase datasource, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the fix in v1.18.7 and obtain a patch/commit diff. Request a minimal proof-of-concept and details on the vulnerable code path (affected datasource component) to confirm attack vector and required privileges; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure and push updates to users to upgrade to v1.18.7.

evidence_quotes.claim: Description of the vulnerability and impact
evidence_quotes.quote: Prior to version 1.18.7, a deserialization vulnerability exists in the DataEase datasource, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary code.
The vulnerability has been fixed in v1.18.7.
There are no known workarounds aside from upgrading.
